title: Concept: OAuth error_description in a response
description: An OAuth error_description field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The field carries the identity provider's internal reason, which can name a client, a redirect URI or a validation rule that the caller was not meant to see.
applicability: Deployments that render an OAuth error_description field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The field carries the identity provider's internal reason, which can name a client, a redirect URI or a validation rule that the caller was not meant to see.
